notes: Count now: 1 (Gestióndo, DOP, stored). No second eligible DOP-priced tool. The page reader would not return the country sentence word for word; the e-CF (Dominican e-invoicing) phrase is used as the country quote. TOI's footer also gives an El Salvador price 'desde US$85/mes' (summary only, not quoted) — the same POS plan without own online ordering, so it does not count in SV.
